Post.post_text: We shipped a new feature today.

summary: phpBB is a PHP/MySQL self-hosted internet forum package (bulletin board): registered users post topics and replies across a nested-set forum tree, moderated via post/topic approve-softdelete-restore and lock/move/merge/split, with private messaging, notifications, search indexing, attachments, bans, warnings, ranks, and an ACP/admin settings layer.
